page_title: FUL 3-0 WOL | Fulham v Wolves 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
90+3' Sander Berge (Fulham) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+2' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Adama Traore (Fulham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' It's time for a substitution. Adama Traore (Fulham) comes on in place of Alex Iwobi.
89' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alex Iwobi (Fulham) takes it short.
88' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

88' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Sam Johnstone pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The referee signals a corner kick to Fulham.
87' The referee awards a corner and Tom Cairney (Fulham) goes over to take it.
86' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) gets to a rebound in the six-yard box and his effort crashes in off the left post!
84' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
83' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 6:2.
80' Tom Cairney (Fulham) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
80' Dangerous play by Ladislav Krejci (Wolves). John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
77' Substitution. Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) in, Harry Wilson out.
76' Vitor Pereira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andre (Wolves) replacing Jorgen Strand Larsen.
75' 3 - 0 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him, it's into his own goal!
74' The referee shows a yellow card to Yerson Mosquera (Wolves). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) comes onto the pitch for Raul Jimenez.
72' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) replaces Kevin.
72' Here comes a substitution. Tom Cairney (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Joshua King.
71' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
70' Harry Wilson (Fulham) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that Sam Johnstone expertly pushes away.
69' Alex Iwobi races towards the box before laying off to Joshua King (Fulham), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
68' Fulham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
65' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
65' The linesman signals that Joshua King (Fulham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
64' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jean-Ricner Bellegarde walks off the pitch to be replaced by Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves).

62' 2 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Harry Wilson (Fulham) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Sam Johnstone. 2:0.
62' Sander Berge (Fulham) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
61' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
61' Joao Gomes (Wolves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Fulham have been awarded a free kick.
61' Harry Wilson (Fulham) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
60' The free kick is delivered by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
59' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for an infringement.

57' Kenny Tete (Fulham) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Sam Johnstone anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
57' Harry Wilson (Fulham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
56' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
56' A long pass, executed by Joachim Andersen (Fulham), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
54' Kenny Tete (Fulham) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.
53' The resulting corner from Kevin (Fulham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

52' Harry Wilson (Fulham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

52' Kenny Tete (Fulham) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Sam Johnstone has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.
51' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
50' Rough tackle by Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Fulham.
48' John Brooks blows his whistle and it's Hugo Bueno (Wolves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
47' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
46' Half-time substitution. Vitor Pereira decided to make a change. Jhon Arias (Wolves) is replaced by Joao Gomes.
46' Half-time substitution. Ki-Jana Hoever (Wolves) will not participate anymore and Jackson Tchatchoua is coming on.
46' Vitor Pereira makes a half-time substitution. Yerson Mosquera comes on in place of Toti (Wolves).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' A brilliant cross into the box finds Ladislav Krejci (Wolves), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
45+3' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
45+1' Sam Johnstone leaps to intercept the corner kick from Kevin (Fulham).
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
43' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
42' Kenny Tete (Fulham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Toti (Wolves) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' Harry Wilson (Fulham) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
36' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
34' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
33' The foul by Kevin (Fulham) was seen by John Brooks who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
31' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
28' John Brooks blows his whistle. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
25' Kevin (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Sam Johnstone comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' There's an opportunity for Alex Iwobi (Fulham) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
22' Harry Wilson (Fulham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
22' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) takes a direct free kick.

22' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul. Fulham win a free kick.
20' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) meets a cross from Toti, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the right post.
20' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
17' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) picks up an injury.
17' Harry Wilson (Fulham) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after the corner and unleashes a shot which flies well wide of the right post.
16' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
15' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) sends a long ball in, but Bernd Leno comfortably gathers the ball.
11' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Hugo Bueno (Wolves).
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Raul Jimenez shows great vision to find Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
5' A corner kick by Wolves is thwarted by the well prepared Bernd Leno (Fulham).
4' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Wolves will take a corner kick.

4' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Bernd Leno was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
1' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) commits a foul during an attacking move.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Wolves will take the kick-off.
John Brooks will supervise the game today.
